title: feat(fillcut): eight F_cut maps fill from one site
science: The strongest result of this batch and a genuine cross-cell synthesis: it intersects the STATIC three-cut class of #6391 with the DYNAMIC fill census of #6393. Of the 32 members of F_cut, exactly N=8 fill the two-cube from the 1-site seed - so imposing the three symmetry cuts AND the fill requirement together still leaves 8 candidates and does not select f_L1.
